state.goal: Research Cloudflare fit and current baseline pricing for a modern AI SaaS

found.text:
Cloudflare Workers Paid pricing, as of the docs last updated August 28, 2026: $5/month minimum, including 10 million requests and 30 million CPU milliseconds each month. Beyond those allowances, requests cost $0.30 per million and CPU time costs $0.02 per additional million milliseconds. There’s no duration charge; the standard per-invocation CPU limit is 30 seconds, configurable up to 5 minutes. ([developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/))
Sources:
[s1] Pricing · Cloudflare Workers docs — https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/

Cloudflare’s 2026 pricing docs list Durable Objects and Workflows on Workers Free and Paid plans.

Durable Objects on Workers Paid include 1 million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds of compute duration per month. Beyond those amounts, requests cost $0.15 per million and duration costs $12.50 per million GB-seconds. SQLite storage and row operations have separate limits and charges. ([developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/pricing/))

Workflows on Workers Paid include 10 million invocations, 30 million CPU milliseconds, 1 GB-month of storage, and 500,000 steps per month. Additional usage costs $0.30 per million invocations, $0.02 per million CPU milliseconds, $0.20 per GB-month, and $0.80 per additional 100,000 steps. ([developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workflows/reference/pricing/))
Sources:
[s2] Pricing · Cloudflare Durable Objects docs — https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/pricing/
[s3] Pricing · Cloudflare Workflows docs — https://developers.cloudflare.com/workflows/reference/pricing/

Cloudflare’s pricing pages show: Queues includes 10,000 operations per day on Workers Free; Workers Paid includes 1 million operations monthly, then $0.40 per million. ([developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/platform/pricing/))

R2 Standard storage costs $0.015/GB-month, with $4.50 per million Class A operations and $0.36 per million Class B operations; internet egress is free. The monthly free tier includes 10 GB-month, 1 million Class A operations, and 10 million Class B operations. ([developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/))

D1 pricing is based on rows read, rows written, and storage. Workers Paid includes 25 billion rows read and 50 million rows written monthly, then charges $0.001 per million rows read and $1 per million rows written; the first 5 GB of storage is included, then $0.75/GB-month. ([developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/pricing/))

Hyperdrive is included with Workers Free and Paid. Free includes 100,000 database queries per day; Paid includes unlimited queries. ([developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/hyperdrive/platform/pricing/))

Vectorize charges according to queried and stored vector dimensions; the pricing page describes the billing metrics, but the search result did not include the unit rates. ([developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/platform/pricing/))
